name: Sale To POI Message Status Response V 08
definition: The SaleToPOIMessageStatusResponse message is sent by a POI System to respond to the sale system at a previous message status request.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Set of characteristics related to the transfer of the request.

StatusResponse.name: Status Response
StatusResponse.definition: Information related to the response of a status request.

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
SecurityTrailer.definition: Trailer of the message containing a MAC or a digital signature.
